tax_litigation.status: The Company have received the Final Order under Service Tax Appeal pronounced on 30.07.2026; on 03-08-2026. The Authority held that the impugned demand of service tax is not sustainable. Accordingly, the same is set aside and no penalties are imposable on the Company. Hence, the appeal filed by the appellant (i.e. Company) is allowed with consequential relief, if any. Therefore, there is no material financial impact on the Company. The intimation in this regard has been submitted with stock exchange on 03.08.2026.
